source: Bontekoe et al (2023) original three separately SHA/MD5-verified public CC0 GPS ZIPs
data_input: Only 3 cohort aggregate JSONs from the selected SINGLE archive per cohort, never raw event rows or tag IDs

analysis.primary: Count exact UTC dates present with at least one valid GPS event in all three selected cohort archives
analysis.pairwise: Count UTC dates present in each of the 3 cohort pairs; no date repeated within cohort
analysis.within_cohort: Preserve counts of days with >=2 distinct tag strings (not actual synchronized positions)
analysis.stratification: Calendar year of valid original GPS date
analysis.inclusion: ALL validated dates in each of the three selected single archived GPS files; no cherry-picking year, location, individual or event by observed outcome
analysis.denominator: Number of exact UTC calendar dates in union of three verified source event sets, NOT animal-years, not migration seasons or all original cohorts

output: Three cohort-year support tables, 3 pairwise date-intersections by calendar year, triple-date intersection, total union dates and number of days with >=2 observed tag strings per cohort. Never raw GPS event row, tag ID, animal ID, original location or exact time of day.
potential_conclusion: At most same UTC-day *temporal coverage* of tagged birds in selected source ZIPs. Does not show same hour, same place, flocking, social information or predictor reliability q. A zero intersection does not prove absence across unscanned other source ZIPs.
